quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #5
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for trucks.
Do not pass trucks.
Truck parking area ahead.
Steep hill ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What color are signs for parks and recreation areas?

options.text: Orange.
Red.
Green.
Brown.

questions.correctAnswerText: Brown.
questions.explanation: Brown signs show parks, historical sites, and recreation areas. They help you find these places when traveling.

questions.question: To check your blind spot before turning left, you should look:

options.text: Over your right shoulder.
At your side mirror.
Over your left shoulder.
At your rearview mirror.

questions.correctAnswerText: Over your left shoulder.
questions.explanation: Look over your shoulder in the direction you want to turn to check your blind spot.

questions.question: When you see a flashing red traffic light, you should:

options.text: Go through if no other cars are coming.
Keep driving. You have the right-of-way.
Stop only if a police officer is nearby.
Treat it like a stop sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: Treat it like a stop sign.
questions.explanation: Flashing red lights mark dangerous intersections. Always treat them like stop signs.

questions.question: If two cars arrive at a four-way stop at the same time, who goes first?

options.text: The car on the left must let the car on the right go first.
The car on the right must let the car on the left go first.
Drivers must use hand signals to decide.
One driver should go without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car on the left must let the car on the right go first.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, cars go in the order they arrive. If two cars arrive at the same time, the car on the left must yield to the car on the right.

questions.question: What lights should you use when driving in fog?

options.text: Parking lights.
Low beam headlights.
High beam headlights.
It does not matter which lights you use.

questions.correctAnswerText: Low beam headlights.
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: A driver entering the highway from an on-ramp must:

options.text: Let drivers already on the highway go first.
Have the right-of-way.
Force their way into traffic.
Assume other drivers will move out of the way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let drivers already on the highway go first.
questions.explanation: When entering a highway from an on-ramp, yield to drivers already on the highway. Merge safely when you have room.

questions.question: ____ limit your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only alcohol above the legal limit can
Alcohol does not
Even a small amount of alcohol can
Only alcohol above 0.05 percent can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even a small amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Even small amounts of alcohol reduce your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory. It will hurt your driving. No amount of alcohol is safe for driving.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn.
A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
Winding road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: How can you avoid getting drowsy on a long drive?

options.text: Turn on the radio.
Drive slower.
Stop and rest regularly.
Move your eyes side to side while driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest regularly.
questions.explanation: On long drives, stop regularly to rest and stretch. Do this even if you do not feel tired.

questions.question: What does a flashing yellow traffic light mean?

options.text: Merging traffic
Slow down and be careful.
Pedestrian crossing
Come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be careful.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: If two drivers arrive at an intersection at the same time:

options.text: The driver on the right has the right-of-way.
The driver on the left has the right-of-way.
One driver can continue without stopping.
One driver should honk to give up their right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: The driver on the right has the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: When two vehicles arrive at an open intersection at the same time, the driver on the right has the right-of-way. You must yield and wait until it is safe to go.

questions.question: A solid yellow line on your side of the centerline means:

options.text: Slow down.
Pass with caution.
Do not pass.
Keep right on hills.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do not pass.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow line next to your lane means you cannot pass other vehicles from your direction.

questions.question: Which light means you should slow down and be careful at an intersection?

options.text: A flashing yellow light
A flashing red light
A solid yellow light
A solid red light

questions.correctAnswerText: A flashing yellow light
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means you should slow down, be careful, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: At a light rail intersection, you should always:

options.text: Look both ways before crossing tracks.
Pay attention and obey all traffic signals.
Share the road with pedestrians and bicyclists.
All of these.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of these.
questions.explanation: Never drive around lowered crossing gates. Always look both ways before crossing train tracks. Always obey signs and traffic signals. Trains share the road with cars and bicyclists.

questions.question: Colorado law requires headlights when you can see less than:

options.text: 500 feet.
1,000 feet.
1,500 feet.
2,000 feet.

questions.correctAnswerText: 1,000 feet.
questions.explanation: Colorado law requires you to use headlights from sunset to sunrise and at any other time when you can see less than 1,000 feet ahead.

questions.question: When approaching a working service or maintenance vehicle:

options.text: Treat it like any other vehicle.
Assume it will let you have the right-of-way.
Yield the right-of-way and be extra careful.
Stop completely until it is out of sight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield the right-of-way and be extra careful.
questions.explanation: Always yield to service vehicles and maintenance equipment working on the road. Be very careful around snowplows and other large vehicles because they can block your view with blowing snow.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should not:

options.text: Check your side and rearview mirrors.
Use a turn signal.
Check for other drivers moving into your lane.
Use your cell phone to call police about the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use your cell phone to call police about the road ahead.
questions.explanation: Before changing lanes, check your mirrors for traffic behind you. Use your turn signal to warn other drivers. Look for vehicles that may also be moving into your lane. Never use your phone while driving.

questions.question: On a freeway, if you miss your exit, you should:

options.text: Make a quick turn from your lane.
Stop and back up.
Keep driving until you find the next exit or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving until you find the next exit or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: Never back up or stop on a freeway. Continue to the next exit or safe location where you can turn around. Backing up on a freeway is illegal.

questions.question: How alcohol affects your reflexes and judgment:

options.text: Is less harmful with beer than wine.
Is less harmful with wine than beer.
Is most harmful with hard cider and mixed drinks.
Depends on how much alcohol is in your blood.

questions.correctAnswerText: Depends on how much alcohol is in your blood.
questions.explanation: Any type of alcohol harms your reflexes and judgment. The type does not matter—only how much alcohol you have consumed.

questions.question: After stopping for a school bus that is unloading children, what should you do?

options.text: Do not proceed until the children wave to you.
Watch for children walking along the side of the road.
Accelerate quickly.
Turn on your emergency flashers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children walking along the side of the road.
questions.explanation: When a school bus stops with its lights flashing, watch for children walking along the road. Always drive carefully around children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Bicycle crossing.
Stop.
Fines double in a work zone.
Stop ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Bicycle crossing.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert drivers to road conditions ahead. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: You are driving on a one-way street. An emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches you. What must you do?

options.text: Drive with your flashers turned on.
Drive toward the nearest roadside and stop.
Speed up and take the nearest exit.
Slow down until the vehicle passes you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive toward the nearest roadside and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches on a one-way street, move to the nearest roadside and stop.

questions.question: You are turning onto a street with multiple lanes in your direction. Which lane should you turn into?

options.text: Turn into the lane closest to your previous lane.
Turn into the lane marked with an arrow.
Turn into the middle lane.
Turn into any lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn into the lane closest to your previous lane.
questions.explanation: When turning onto a street with multiple lanes, turn into the lane closest to your previous lane. Do not change lanes while turning.

questions.question: You are waiting in a line at a stop sign. The vehicles ahead pass through and there is no cross traffic. What should you do?

options.text: You may proceed through the intersection without stopping again.
You must stop again at the stop sign or stop line before proceeding.
You may slowly roll past the stop sign.
You may follow the vehicle directly ahead of you without stopping.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must stop again at the stop sign or stop line before proceeding.
questions.explanation: You must always make a complete stop at a stop sign and check for approaching traffic before proceeding. Do not let other drivers pressure you to skip this stop.
